subject: Proposal: Seed Credits for Regional Maintainer Roundtables
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Moreno <eliza@signalforge.org>, maintainers@openstitch.org, organizers@hackhub.org
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Seed Credits for Regional Maintainer Roundtables

Hi Eliza + OpenStitch/HackHub organizers,

Quick note from the Redwood community grants team — thanks for the earlier call. We ran the numbers and think a small pool of credits tied to regionally organized maintainer roundtables would be an effective way to: 1) get more first-time maintainers into cohort events, 2) surface accessibility gaps, and 3) generate content for our maintainer playbook.

Proposal (high level):
- One-time seed pool: 40k compute credits (valid for 90 days) split across 8 roundtables (5k each).
- Each roundtable: 10–12 maintainers, modest travel stipend options handled by the organizer, and 1–2 mentoring hours from Redwood engineers (volunteer rota).
- Prioritization: first-time maintainers + projects with a clear accessibility or onboarding gap.

Attachments: roundtable_recipients.csv (proposed invite list), invitation_template.docx, budget_breakdown.xlsx.

Ask:
- Do maintainers/orgs accept credits as the primary fulfilment mechanism?
- Can HackHub/OpenStitch confirm event owners and 2 dates per suggested region by next week?
- Internally I need a quick thumbs-up from Product/Grants (Jonas) for the 40k pool; Marissa, would you mind a quick budget sanity check?

If this looks reasonable I can route an internal approval and publish a short signup doc.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Developer Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: [roundtable_recipients.csv (csv), invitation_template.docx (docx), budget_breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: Seed Credits for Regional Maintainer Roundtables

Thanks Ben — this is a nice, focused ask. A couple quick notes:

- Prioritize first-time maintainers and projects with <25 monthly contributors for initial pilot; helps measure lift.
- Can we size the 5k per event to support ~6–8 hours of CPU-equivalent activity (so they can run workshops + short demos)? If not, we should state limits in the invite.
- Please add a line in the invitation template about reporting (1 short outcomes note + 3 screenshots/logs) — it helps justify the spend.

On budget: 40k credits sounds fine for a pilot, but split needs to include a 10% ops buffer (ticketing, gift cards for travel). I'll attach a quick markup (budget_breakdown.xlsx) with suggested categories.

Marissa
Director, Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks — OpenStitch is excited about the idea. A few practical items from our side:

1) Dates: we can host in London (Nov 11–12) and Berlin (Nov 18–19).
2) Travel stipends: organizers generally prefer a small reimbursement instead of credits when travel is involved — is there any flexibility to pair a modest stipend per attendee (e.g., $150) with the compute credits?
3) Reporting: happy to provide the outcomes note and screenshots; can you confirm minimum deliverables?

If stipends are a hard no, we can still proceed with credits only — but it affects attendance for contributors outside the EU.

Best,
Eliza Moreno
Community Lead — SignalForge / OpenStitch events

Thanks Eliza — great timing. Jonas, Marissa: looping you for final approval on the pool + the stipend ask. Quick thoughts while we wait for formal sign-off:

- On stipends: We have some flexibility from the discretionary marketing/engagement fund to top up small travel stipends (<= $150) for confirmed events in EMEA/APAC. If Jonas gives the go-ahead I can earmark $6k for stipends (approx 40 attendees at $150).
- Ops/process: Soojin, can your team publish the sign-up doc (Drive link above) and a short HubSpot intake form? I want organizers to register event owners + anticipated attendee list by Sep 10.
- Fulfilment: Credits will be provisioned as promo codes tied to organizer accounts; I'll include redemption instructions in the invite template.

If no objections I will: 1) route the 40k credit pool and $6k stipend ask to Finance for approval, 2) update the invitation template to call out reporting expectations, and 3) share a short promotional email copy for organizers.

Ben
Account Executive, Developer Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: [invitation_template.docx (updated)]
